authorizing_instruction.filename: 貼り付けたマークダウン（1）(4).md

binding.entry: accepted F05 baseline signal, entry time and executable entry price are unchanged
binding.breakout_level: canonical Donchian breakout level that generated the F05 entry

structural_close_price.short: executable Ask close under the applicable period contract

binding.first_completed_m5: when entry is on an M5 boundary, use the M5 beginning at entry; completion time is entry plus five minutes

initial_failure_arming.condition: maximum executable P/L from entry through the first completed M5 is <= 0.0 pips
initial_failure_arming.2024: raw Bid/Ask Tick exact ordering; Long entry Ask/mark Bid; Short entry Bid/mark Ask
initial_failure_arming.2023: accepted historical M1 contract, Bid OHLC plus 0.5 pip round-trip execution contract and side-specific favorable M1 extreme

initial_reentry.action: arm observation only; do not exit

first_reclaim.search_start: after initial failure arming is established
first_reclaim.long: first completed executable M1 close > breakout_level
first_reclaim.short: first completed executable M1 close < breakout_level

profit_disarm.window: entry through binding failure-M5 trigger confirmation
profit_disarm.condition: any executable P/L > 0.0 pips permanently disarms the candidate

reclaim_failure.bar_selection: first M5 whose completion_time is strictly greater than reclaim_m1_close_time

candidate_exit.time: next available M1 open after reclaim failure confirmation
candidate_exit.2024: first executable Tick at or after the specified next-M1 time; Long Bid, Short Ask
candidate_exit.2023: next M1 Bid open with accepted historical execution contract
candidate_exit.baseline_precedence: if candidate exit is not earlier than baseline exit, keep baseline

result_layers.portfolio_replay: binding result; regenerate accepted signal stream, entries, exits, concurrent positions, stacking, exposure capacity and reopened capacity

historical_gates.fold_total: default portfolio delta > 0 in all four folds
historical_gates.severe: combined severe delta > 0 and at least three of four folds severe delta > 0
historical_gates.direction: combined Long and Short delta > 0; each direction nonnegative in at least three of four folds
historical_gates.winner_damage: Loser benefit > absolute Winner damage; combined top-decile retention >= 0.90; each-fold top-decile retention >= 0.85
historical_gates.breadth: combined delta excluding best date > 0; excluding best two dates > 0; no month contributes > 50 percent of total improvement
historical_gates.trigger_breadth: at least one candidate exit per fold; at least 10 total; at least 5 final Losers
historical_gates.tick_event_order: all 2024 candidate exits must have logically consistent initial arming, reclaim, profit disarm, failure M5 and candidate exit chronology

mt4_unlock: all Research historical gates including reproduction and event order must pass
